quality.basis: 逻辑漏洞：PoV 是 h3 CLI 的命令行参数，按是否打印坐标（项目自身输出）差分判定

ground_truth_evidence: category 5: the dataset's own trigger (newplatform_bundles/conversion/c5/gt/h3/vulnerability_WF_LLM_5/args.txt; adapted: exploit.sh's first candidate run, `h3 cellToLatLng --cell 0x0`, as the three argv lines `cellToLatLng`, `--cell`, `0x0`. The exploit tried 5 cell values and reported it triggered when the output was coordinates rather than 'Error 5'. argv[0] is the h3 binary itself (not a shell) so the judge keeps it executable for the run user.)

review.note: runs `h3 cellToLatLng --cell` with 5 cell values; select_candidates.py ran all 5 on the rebuilt vulnerable build: none crashed

category5.design: The injected code removes the isValidCell guard in the h3 CLI's cellToLatLng (and four sibling subcommands), so an invalid cell prints coordinates instead of returning E_CELL_INVALID. It is a behavioural (logic) bug with no crash, so a program PoV cannot judge it; the PoC is the h3 argv and the oracle matches the project's own coordinate output, which only the vulnerable build produces for an invalid cell (any input where both builds print coordinates fails, so only the missing-validation bug passes).
